title: Maintainer governs a round from declaration through append-in-place close
summary: A maintainer uses deterministic, role-bounded round commands to preserve committed intent under work/rounds, record observations under work/audit, emit machine proof under record/proofs, and close without moving authority between those trees.
lifecycle_reason: The round lifecycle is deterministic, human-directed governance; it does not invoke the experimental autonomous controller.

permissions_required: The constitutional role required by each round transition

preconditions: DEVAI adoption has seeded work/rounds, work/audit, record/proofs, and the managed .devai/worktrees root
The maintainer has selected an unused round identifier
The repository has a materialized binding authority policy

steps.action: Create a managed worktree and scaffold the selected committed round intent
steps.expected_outcome: The task executes under .devai/worktrees and a deterministic conforming skeleton is created under work/rounds without creating audit or proof claims

steps.action: Declare the round under the required role and inspect its status
steps.expected_outcome: The declaration remains under work/rounds, is schema-valid and role-attributed, and status reports only the state actually present

steps.action: Complete the declared waves, gates, close decision, and phase-closure evidence
steps.expected_outcome: Committed intent and appendices remain under work/rounds, attributable observations remain under work/audit, and validated verbs emit closure evidence under record/proofs

steps.action: Close the round with Architect authority and explicit write consent
steps.expected_outcome: DEVAI refuses every incomplete close; otherwise it appends attributable close state without moving committed intent, validates the separate audit and proof trees, and leaves a reviewable post-close change

postconditions: The closed round retains schema-valid committed intent with attributable appendices plus separate audit and machine-proof records
The managed .devai/worktrees task directory can be cleaned without moving or deleting committed round intent
Any unified round ledger is derived reproducibly from the three authoritative trees
No supported round command invokes or promotes experimental autonomous execution

acceptance_criteria.statement: Scaffold, declare, and status are deterministic and preserve committed intent, separate observations, separate machine proof, and the managed-worktree boundary.
Close fails closed until the binding gates, close decision, phase closure, and complete attributable three-tree record are present, and it never moves committed intent.
The supported round lifecycle remains human-directed and does not widen the experimental autonomous controller.
A fresh or upgraded adopter receives the work/rounds, work/audit, record/proofs, .devai/worktrees, and ignore boundaries needed to execute the journey.

provenance: supersedes JNY-007 (Owner mark 2026-07-23): round governance is the successor process
OM-002 (Owner mark 2026-07-24): three-tree doctrine and .devai/worktrees are approved
